title: Maharam-Pollicott-Ruelle resonances and self-similar translation flows on abelian covers
summary: We study self-similar translation flows on $\mathbb Z^d$-covers of compact translation surfaces. Our main goal is to investigate their ergodic properties with respect to general Maharam measures. To this end, we develop a renormalization approach based on a family of twisted transfer operators associated with the renormalizing pseudo-Anosov map acting on anisotropic spaces of distributions.
